mermaid.message: Mermaid names allow letters, digits and underscores only; tables renamed: primary.public.customers → primary_public_customers, primary.public.orders → primary_public_orders, replica.customers → replica_customers, replica.orders → replica_orders.
A Mermaid ER diagram holds tables, columns, keys and foreign keys only; left out of primary: 1 index, 2 column defaults, 1 referential action set.
A Mermaid ER diagram holds tables, columns, keys and foreign keys only; left out of replica: 1 index, 1 column default, 1 referential action set.

dbml.message: DBML has one namespace per file: with several connections, each table is named by its connection and table, such as "app.public.users".
